result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_jaccard_similarity()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get Jaccard similarity index between all node pairs. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L9168-L9223){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_jaccard_similarity() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} The Jaccard index is a classic set similarity measure: `Jaccard(A, B) = |neighbors(A) ∩ neighbors(B)| / |neighbors(A) ∪ neighbors(B)|` Range: `[0, 1]` where `0` means no common neighbors and `1` means identical neighborhoods (or same node). More conservative than Dice coefficient (always ≤ Dice score). Self-similarity is always `1.0`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict[int, dict[int, float]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Nested dictionary mapping node IDs to dictionaries of similarity scores. Format: `{node1_id: {node2_id: similarity_score}}`. ::: ## Common Use Cases {.doc-common-use-cases} - document similarity (bag-of-words) - user similarity (common items/friends) - biological networks (protein interactions) ## Examples {.doc-examples} In a star graph, the leaves share no neighbors with each other -- only with the hub -- so their pairwise Jaccard similarity is `0.0`: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Every leaf of this star shares the hub as a common neighbor, so their pairwise similarity reflects that shared connection rather than being zero: ::: {#50793ee4 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="hub") .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("hub", "A") .add_edge("hub", "B") .add_edge("hub", "C") ) sim = graph.get_jaccard_similarity() a_id = graph.get_id_from_label("A") b_id = graph.get_id_from_label("B") sim[a_id][b_id] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1.0 ``` ::: :::
